channel.title: Global Arbitration Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Arbitration Review (globalarbitrationreview.com)

item.title: LCIA hears claim over tyre recycling plant
item.description: A joint venture led by a French private equity firm has filed a €54 million LCIA claim against its Swedish technology partner in a tyre recycling project.

item.title: Baker Botts partner goes solo in Houston
item.description: Ben Love, who is advising on treaty claims against Guinea and Vietnam, has left the partnership at Baker Botts to set up his own practice in Houston.

item.title: Singapore court won’t revive SIAC case scuppered by sanctions
item.description: The Singapore High Court has upheld a SIAC tribunal’s decision to terminate a nine-figure debt claim on the basis that continuing with the arbitration had become “impossible” due to sanctions.

item.title: BVI charging order upheld in Iraqi telecoms dispute
item.description: A Caribbean court has upheld a provisional charging order granted in aid of efforts to enforce a US$1.6 billion ICC award – finding the BVI courts can freeze shares registered in the name of a third party who is alleged to be a nominee of one of the Iraqi award debtors.

item.title: Valuation without a playbook: assessing quantum in crypto, pharma and AI
item.description: A panel at GAR Live Damages discussed the challenges of determining quantum in fast-moving industries such as cryptocurrency, life sciences and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Vienna gets palatial new hearing centre
item.description: A new hearing centre for arbitrations, mediations and other high-level legal proceedings has opened in an iconic baroque palace in Vienna, strengthening the Austrian capital as a European hub for international dispute resolution.

item.title: Romanian arbitrator joins Eversheds
item.description: Luminita Popa has joined Eversheds Sutherland as a partner in Bucharest, a year and a half after leaving Romanian firm Suciu Popa to launch an independent arbitrator practice.

item.title: Samsung brings new ICC claim in billion-dollar royalties dispute
item.description: South Korea’s Samsung has filed a new ICC claim against InterDigital after a tribunal determined that the US tech developer should receive US$1.05 billion in royalties under a renewed patent licence for its cellular wireless and video technologies.

item.title: Electricity investors launch tax claim against Peru
item.description: US investors have brought a US$60 million ICSID claim against Peru over a tax on the sale of an electricity distribution business.

item.title: Panama port dispute escalates with treaty notice
item.description: Hong Kong-based conglomerate CK Hutchison Holdings has threatened Panama with an investment treaty claim over alleged efforts to strip it of a port concession – days after filing an ICC claim.
